name: Notre-Dame Cathedral in Tournai
description: Rising above the Walloon city of Tournai in Belgium, this cathedral was begun in the early 12th century and still has a huge Romanesque nave, its stone columns topped with richly carved capitals. Five slender towers crown the transept, giving the skyline a distinctive silhouette. The choir was rebuilt in the 13th century in pure Gothic style, so you can walk from one era into the next.
